cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: The Conspiracy Expands
cards.instruction: Use every denial, coincidence, and missing detail as proof that more people and higher stakes are involved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Our toaster receipt is gone. The shop must have someone inside this house.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I probably recycled it. We can get a copy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. So the recycling crew removes originals while the shop prints replacements.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Every shop? Then it's the whole high street. We can't trust a single warranty.

mechanism: A claims control of a household investigation and restricts ordinary remedies as every explanation enlarges the supposed network.
confusable: Unlike simple suspicion of one shop, A expands participants and threatened warranties with each benign fact.
comparison: Domestic receipt recovery becomes a high-street conspiracy, unlike a rail passenger interpreting a regional fault as career sabotage.
seedUse: Use recycling, replacement receipts and all shops; make S01 authorize or forbid responses according to the expanding conspiracy.
